measured.bundling: esbuild, minified, format esm, platform neutral, conditions source/workerd/worker/browser/import, cloudflare:* and node:* external; gzip -9

appJson.fallbackReason: the sweep delivers every outbox row to every subscription and resumes every workflow, so it needs the whole subscription table and every workflow closure (T2 finding 6); it is also the dispatch owner for sliced groups
runtime surfaces outside the manifest (views, projections, caches, schedule routes, changesets, imports, admin, objects, metadata) have no closure; changesets can call any operation
